dungeon-enter.approachTemplate: A marked shaft mouth — the Deep Mine (mobs {band}, +1 per floor). Click or step in to delve.

stairs-down.approachTemplate: Stairs marked Deeper — click to descend another floor.

stairs-up.approachTemplate: Stairs marked Climb — step on them to go up (floor 1 exits to Darkmine).

surface-portal.approachTemplate: Escape shaft — click to return to Darkmine; it remembers this floor.

den-boulder.approachTemplate: A sealing boulder — mine it with a diamond pickaxe to open the Dragon Den ({summary}).

dragon-den.approachTemplate: Scorched cave mouth — Dragon Den ({summary}). Click or step in to enter.

dragon-den-exit.approachTemplate: Tunnel back to Windrock Highlands ({summary}) — click or step on it to leave.
